name.ja: HGUC 1/144 BHC専用エコプラ ガンキャノン
name.en: HGUC 1/144 BHC exclusive eco plastic gun cannon

description.ja: ●「機動戦士ガンダム」に登場する機体をエコプラでキット化
description.en: ●The aircraft that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam" is made into a kit using Ecopla.

description.ja: ●キャノン発射体勢を、平手パーツと腹部可動により再現可能
description.en: -Cannon firing position can be reproduced with open hand parts and abdominal movable parts

description.ja: ●両肩の240mmキャノンのマウント部にスプレーミサイルランチャーも交換装着が可能
description.en: - Spray missile launchers can also be replaced and installed on the 240mm cannon mounts on both shoulders.
